context: A teacher and student discuss an environmental research paper
purpose: Teach: 唱える/全域/山頂/代償/盛況/訳者/塗料/無謀

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、SDGsを唱える章、丁寧ですね。
lines.en: Your paper's SDGs chapter is really thoughtfully done.
lines.style: Warm, observant nod. Slow, measured pace. Eyes steady on his work. The tone of a teacher noticing genuine effort, not performing praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被害は地域全域に及び、深刻でした。
lines.en: Yes. The damage spread across the entire region—it was serious.
lines.style: Quiet, focused delivery. Slight pause before the dash, as if recalling the weight of the findings. Steady conviction, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 山頂部の植生変化、写真資料も豊富ですね。
lines.en: The vegetation changes at the summit—and you've got plenty of photo documentation to back it up.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly, genuinely engaged. Warm acknowledgment in the voice. Each phrase lands with clear interest, not checking boxes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 対策の代償、別章で論じています。
lines.en: The costs of those countermeasures—you're examining that in a separate section.
lines.style: Thoughtful inquiry. A gentle probe, testing whether he's thought the implications through. Soft lift at the end, inviting him to elaborate.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 関連シンポジウム、盛況でしたね。
lines.en: The related symposium had a strong turnout, didn't it.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly nostalgic. Slower cadence. A moment of stepping back to appreciate the broader context, not rushing the observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。翻訳の訳者にも、丁寧に解説してもらいました。
lines.en: Yes. The translator actually walked me through it all quite carefully.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude beneath the surface. Simple, unadorned delivery. A small smile in the voice—relief that someone took time to explain it well.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 塗料原料の研究、特定企業の無謀な開発も、議論に上りました。
lines.en: The research on paint-material sourcing—and some of those corporate development practices came up too. Reckless choices.
lines.style: Calm, measured close. Clear-eyed assessment without heat. The faintest weight on 'reckless,' a quiet conviction. Trailing thought, like she's turning it over one more time.
